thread:
Mira Chen: Prim here. Quick pass for the night — saw a spike of KV-eviction-induced 503s hitting embeddings between 00:12-00:37 UTC. Pager popped ~00:15. Mitigations applied, most traffic recovered by 01:05 UTC. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: pager triggered: embeddings-503-threshold (sev3) at 00:15 UTC. Affected region: eu-west. Top symptoms: sustained p95 token latency 2.4s, 503s ~7% of requests. Links: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/emb-503-9812340000

Jordan Park: I picked up the page at 00:18. Repro'd locally on staging using load-replay, confirmed eviction storms when autoscaler churned leaders. Root cause looks like cache leader flapping after a recent config bump to eviction_threshold. :thinking_face:

Sam Patel: Thanks @Jordan. What was the quick mitigation you put?

Jordan Park: Rolled back eviction_threshold to previous value (from 0.67 -> 0.55) on eu-west autoscaler group, and pinned primary leader on 3 nodes to stop churn. Command I ran (logs below):
```bash
# rollback config
redwoodctl config set autoscaler.eviction_threshold 0.55 --region eu-west --env prod
redwoodctl restart autoscaler --group eu-west-emb
```
Logs show leader transitions drop quickly after restart.

Alex Liu: Canary for the config change had been green, but missed the tail workloads. Noted. I also toggled conservative backpressure on the embed-queue for 20m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed for autoscaler config in eu-west at 00:29 UTC by Jordan Park. Change-id: cfg-evict-2026-07-12-9812

Mira Chen: Current status: embedding requests normalizing, 503 rate down to 0.5%. Still some p95 noise ~1.1s. Impact: ~2% of active customers in eu-west experienced degraded responses for ~45m. No active customer pages open.

Sam Patel: Coverage notes for next shift — Primary: Mira (until 04:00 UTC), Secondary: Jordan (on-call until 06:00 UTC). EU-night rotation gap from 02:00-03:00 UTC might be thin (no dedicated SRE until 02:30), recommend blur-call if any regressions.

Mira Chen: Action items for handoff:
- Add watch on autoscaler leader count and eviction_rate (dash: embeds/eu-west/eviction) :eyes:
- Run `redis-cluster health` every 15m for the next 2 hours if eviction_rate > 0.5%
- If 503 > 1% for 10m, escalate to sev2 and start rollback of any recent deploys
- Link to runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings-eviction (see section "temporary pin & rollback")

Jordan Park: Noted. I'll keep an eye on the canary metric pipelines. If we see autoscaler churn again, I'll snapshot the leader state and force pin.

Alex Liu: Also leaving a small script in ops-snippets to check leader flaps quickly: `ops/check-leaders.sh eu-west` (permission: ops-team).

Mira Chen: Final handoff status: primary stays on Mira until 04:00, secondary Jordan until 06:00. No unresolved pages. Follow-ups: Alex to run a post-mortem of the canary coverage (owner: Alex), Sam to update runbook with clearer canary workloads (owner: Sam).

Sam Patel: I'll add the canary workloads and a checklist for long-tail traffic tests. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Mira Chen: Thanks team. If anything flares, ping @Jordan and @Mira, escalate to sev2 if customer-facing error rate rises. :phone:
